description: A plant virus that infects peppers and many other crops. It spreads mainly by aphids and causes mosaic patterns, leaf deformation and reduced plant growth.
favorable_conditions: Pepper fields close to alfalfa crops
management: Plant peppers away from alfalfa fields
Use barrier crops such as corn
Use trap crops such as peas
biological_control: Use natural predators such as lady beetles
Use minute pirate bugs (Orius spp.) to reduce aphid populations
Encourage beneficial insects in the field
chemical_control: Mineral oil sprays to reduce virus transmission
Kaolin clay sprays to deter aphids
prevention: Keep distance between peppers and alfalfa fields
Use reflective mulch or straw mulch to repel aphids
Control aphid populations in surrounding crops
